observed.failure: Real cjb2 output ended at an odd final chunk boundary. The bounded parser incorrectly demanded its alignment byte inside the containing FORM.
observed.evidence: Decoded GitHub job log and matching upload/API artifact identity. No independent ZIP readback.

publisher_source.behavior: get_chunk returns when the offset equals the current context end before skipping the next-sibling alignment byte. put_chunk writes alignment before a new chunk; close_chunk records the exact current offset without appending padding.

repair.product: Allow an odd chunk to terminate exactly at its declared containing FORM boundary. Keep exact top-level length, overrun refusal, sibling alignment, depth/chunk/page budgets and indirect/shared dictionary refusal.
repair.gate: A frozen branch containing djvu-framing executes only the unchanged required DjVu native population, with all 162 source and installed portable boundaries; ordinary branches retain all three legacy families.

limitations: Only execution of the new gate can qualify this repair.
No DjVu OCR or shared dictionaries are enabled.
Existing CHM malformed-HTML failure remains separate.
